title: Fused-ring topology orchestrates crystallographic control and polyiodide sequestration for ultra-durable zinc–iodine batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07366A, Paper
Yan Jin, Jihao Qin, Jin Cao, Zhenyang Zhang, Xin An, Shenghan Wang, Xuelin Yang
A bifunctional fused-ring modulator orchestrates (100)-oriented Zn deposition via π–π stacking and anchors polyiodides. This dual-site regulation enables dendrite-free, ultra-durable aqueous zinc–iodine batteries.
